author: Jason Stys
summary: Compare active and draft policies using the same evidence and time, with exact native OPA inputs and failure states.
rationale: Supports controlled policy review without publishing a draft or treating a comparison as flight authorization.
limitations: Bounded organizational checklist using fictional self-reported evidence, not complete/current law or verified approval.
An unpublished comparison is not persisted human review and grants no flight or legal authorization.
No real aircraft, surveillance or external authorization service is controlled. Source/package validation does not supply a public native desktop release.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
